items.title: Some Assembly Required: Complete Series + Extras
items.description: Complete collection of the Canadian teen sitcom "Some Assembly Required" (2014–2016), originally broadcast on YTV. Includes all three seasons of the series along with a compiled collection of surviving behind-the-scenes (BTS) featurettes, promotional clips, cast interviews, and extras.
